flint_runtime:
pretty = True      # pretty-print repr() output
unicode = False    # use unicode characters in output
prec = 128         # real/complex precision (in bits)
dps = 38           # real/complex precision (in digits)
cap = 10           # power series precision
threads = 1        # max number of threads used internally
scope: exact finite cell (13,2) only; no universal H2a, H2b, route-promotion, or RH claim

source_formula.prime_weight: vonMangoldt k * (sqrt k)^(-1) * ccmQKernel L n m (log k)
source_formula.tau_formula: ccmW02Entry L n m - ccmWREntry L n m - ccmPrimeEntryN1 13 n m
source_formula.wr_endpoint: certified analytic removable extension at x=0
